solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Proposal must incorporate one tax as incentive

indicators.note: to incorporate is to take something in, so the proposal word holds the other pieces within it

parts.note: a motion is a proposal put to a meeting
one is the Roman numeral I
VAT is value added tax, the UK sales tax

explanation.surface: Someone suggests a tax be built into a proposal as a way of encouraging people.
explanation.definitionFit: Motivation is the drive or reason that spurs action, which is what an incentive provides.

clue.text: Bloke regularly found after motorway exploit

indicators.note: found after means the picked letters come behind the motorway

parts.note: the M1 is the main motorway from London to Leeds, written MI

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the word Bloke

explanation.surface: A man is spotted regularly behind the motorway, taking advantage.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is Britain's first long-distance motorway; crosswords treat the figure 1 as the letter I, so it gives MI.
explanation.definitionFit: To milk a situation is to exploit it, drawing out every possible advantage.

clue.text: Be the best independent state of current interest

parts.note: to top is to be the best, to come first
CAL is an abbreviation for California, a US state

explanation.surface: An independent state excelling is the issue of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: A topical matter is one relevant to current events, of present interest.

clue.text: Window dressing from Italian student wearing tie?

parts.note: a Venetian is an Italian from Venice

indicators.note: wearing means the tie word has the student piece on, wrapped around it

parts.note: to bind is to tie
L is for learner, a student driver

explanation.surface: Asks whether an Italian student in a tie counts as window dressing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' is a link. 'Window dressing' sounds like shop display, but it means literally a covering for a window.
explanation.definitionFit: A Venetian blind, made of horizontal slats, is literally something that dresses a window.

clue.text: Circle pitch on the outside in efforts to get awards

indicators.note: on the outside means the word for efforts surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: tries are efforts or attempts
O is shaped like a circle
PH is taken as an abbreviation for pitch

explanation.surface: A circular pitch is surrounded by people striving to win prizes.
explanation.definitionFit: Trophies are cups and similar prizes given as awards for victory.

clue.text: Drug ring sourcing products in upper Mongolia

parts.note: O is shaped like a ring

indicators.note: sourcing means taking the source, the start, of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A drug network obtaining goods in northern Mongolia.
explanation.definitionFit: Opium is a narcotic drug extracted from the opium poppy.

clue.text: Mark is almost frightening

indicators.note: almost means the word falls just short, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: frightening means scary

explanation.surface: Some blemish is described as nearly terrifying.
explanation.definitionFit: A scar is a lasting mark left on the skin after a wound heals.

clue.text: Riddle for cleaner with a debt halved

parts.note: a char, or charwoman, is a British term for a cleaning lady

indicators.note: halved means only the first half of the word debt is kept

explanation.surface: Asks for a puzzle about a cleaner who has cut her debt by half.
explanation.definitionFit: A charade is a riddle acted out or worded syllable by syllable, as in the parlour game.

clue.text: Impressive houses in recessed parts

indicators.note: parts, as a verb, means splits up, so the letters are separated and reassembled

explanation.surface: Grand homes built into recessed sections.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'in' that looks like a link is part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Residences is a formal word for homes, often grand ones like an official residence.

clue.text: Flower girl finally out of bed and home

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word girl

parts.note: someone out of bed is up
at home means in

explanation.surface: A flower girl at a wedding has finally got up and gone home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower girl' reads as one wedding role, but 'Flower' alone is the definition and 'girl finally' gives only the L.
explanation.definitionFit: The lupin is a garden plant grown for its tall spikes of pea-like blooms.

clue.text: The sort of oils found in working grain silo?

indicators.note: working suggests the letters are being worked over into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Asks what kind of oil might turn up inside a grain silo in operation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oils' means oil paintings, not lubricants or cooking oils: the clue asks for paintings that are not copies. 'found in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Originals are the authentic paintings themselves, as opposed to reproductions or prints of them.

clue.text: Works of art for military bases

definitions.meaning: an installation is a large artwork assembled in a gallery space
military establishments such as bases and depots

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both gallery artworks built in place and military establishments.

clue.text: Be good enough and much trusted at cooking

indicators.note: cooking suggests the letters are being stirred up and transformed

explanation.surface: A cook greatly trusted in the kitchen is praised as up to the job.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram takes all of 'much trusted at', thirteen letters, including the little 'at'.
explanation.definitionFit: To cut the mustard is an idiom meaning to come up to the required standard.

clue.text: Hopeless hot racer's love, initially, of big band music

indicators.note: hopeless suggests something botched and in a mess, so the letters are jumbled
initially means take just the first letter of love

explanation.surface: A hopeless racing driver's girlfriend is into big band music.
explanation.definitionFit: Orchestral describes music for an orchestra, the biggest of big bands.

clue.text: Discharged soldiers left and relaxed

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, is a common crossword shorthand for soldiers
eased means relaxed or loosened

explanation.surface: Soldiers were discharged, then left and unwound.
explanation.definitionFit: Released and discharged both mean let go or set free, as from service or custody.

clue.text: Boozer, say, in the outskirts of Taunton

indicators.note: in places the word for say inside the letters taken from Taunton
the outskirts of a town are its edges, so take the first and last letters of Taunton

parts.note: to aver is to say or assert

explanation.surface: A pub, for instance, on the edge of the Somerset town of Taunton.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boozer' is British slang for a pub, not a drinker. Taunton is the county town of Somerset in England.
explanation.definitionFit: A boozer is informal British slang for a pub, which is what a tavern is.

clue.text: Run-down theatre has it after December

indicators.note: after sends the theatre and the it pieces behind the month

parts.note: rep is short for repertory theatre

explanation.surface: A shabby theatre that only gets going after December.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Run-down' as the definition means shabby, not a summary; 'has' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Decrepit means worn out or dilapidated, which is what run-down means.

clue.text: Present times as a result of this

parts.note: present, as in attending, means here
times as in multiplication, two times three, is by

explanation.surface: A formal phrase announcing that present times are a consequence of this.
explanation.definitionFit: Hereby is a formal adverb meaning by means of or as a result of this document or act.

clue.text: Pitch up with courses and short cuts for motorists

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: pitch is tar
runs are courses, as in ski runs

explanation.surface: A football pitch is put up alongside routes for drivers.
explanation.walkthrough: Rat runs are British slang for back streets drivers use to dodge traffic. 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Rat runs are minor roads used by drivers as short cuts to avoid main-road congestion.

clue.text: Skilfully produced cheese rejected after spring

indicators.note: after means the reversed cheese comes behind the word for spring

parts.note: a well is a spring of water

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the cheese word is turned round

parts.note: Edam is a Dutch cheese

explanation.surface: Something crafted with care, though cheese was turned down after the spring season.
explanation.definitionFit: Something well-made has been constructed with skill and care.

clue.text: Heartless boy adopted by fools is pits

indicators.note: adopted by means taken in by, so the fools word holds the other piece

parts.note: asses are fools

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letter of boy is removed

explanation.surface: A heartless lad taken in by idiots is the pits.
explanation.definitionFit: Abysses are deep chasms or bottomless pits.

clue.text: What Parliament may be doing fairly, but in an advantageous position

parts.note: Parliament is said to be sitting when in session
pretty means fairly, as in pretty good

explanation.surface: Contrasts parliamentary proceedings conducted fairly with being well placed.
explanation.definitionFit: Sitting pretty is an idiom for being comfortably placed and well off.

clue.text: Pull up a policeman abroad

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to drag is to pull

explanation.surface: An instruction to pull over a foreign officer.
explanation.walkthrough: A garda is a member of the Garda Síochána, the police force of Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Garda is the Irish word for a police officer, so a policeman abroad from a British view.

clue.text: Murphy has time for quiet game of poker

indicators.note: for means one letter stands in place of another

parts.note: a murphy is slang for a potato, a spud
P, piano, is the musical notation for quiet

explanation.surface: A man named Murphy trades quiet time for a hand of cards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' is a link: the potato swaps its P for T.
explanation.definitionFit: Stud is a form of poker in which some cards are dealt face up.

clue.text: Journey made for a game of golf?

definitions.text: Journey made for a game of golf?

parts.words: Journey made for a game of golf?
parts.note: a journey that brings you back where you started; read playfully, an outing whose purpose is a game of golf, a single complete circuit of the course

explanation.definitionFit: A round trip is a journey out and back to the starting point, and in golf a round is one game.

clue.text: Working, and ready for attack

parts.note: a machine that is working is on
set means ready, as in ready, steady, go

explanation.surface: Something is in operation and prepared for an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: An onset is the beginning of an attack or assault, as in the onset of an illness or charge.

clue.text: Disorientated, look at the road

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold
ST is the abbreviation for street, a road

explanation.surface: Someone confused stares at the road ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: Being lost means not knowing where you are, which is to be disorientated.

clue.text: Imagined stains fade out

indicators.note: out signals the letters are thrown out of their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone dreamt that the stains would fade away.
explanation.definitionFit: To fantasise is to indulge in daydreams, so fantasised means imagined.
